title: Artificial Intelligence Overview
content: A comprehensive overview of artificial intelligence, its branches, applications, and future prospects.

children.title: Machine Learning
children.content: Algorithms that enable computers to learn and improve from experience without being explicitly programmed.

children.title: Supervised Learning
children.content: Learning with labeled training data to make predictions on new data.

children.title: Classification
children.content: Predicting discrete categories or classes.

children.title: Regression
children.content: Predicting continuous numerical values.

children.title: Unsupervised Learning
children.content: Finding patterns in data without labeled examples.

children.title: Clustering
children.content: Grouping similar data points together.

children.title: Dimensionality Reduction
children.content: Reducing the number of features while preserving important information.

children.title: Reinforcement Learning
children.content: Learning through interaction with an environment using rewards and penalties.

children.title: Deep Learning
children.content: Neural networks with multiple layers that can learn complex patterns.

children.title: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)
children.content: Specialized for processing grid-like data such as images.

children.title: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs)
children.content: Designed for sequential data like time series or natural language.

children.title: Transformers
children.content: Architecture using attention mechanisms, revolutionizing NLP and beyond.

children.title: Natural Language Processing
children.content: Enabling computers to understand, interpret, and generate human language.

children.title: Text Analysis
children.content: Extracting insights and meaning from textual data.

children.title: Language Generation
children.content: Creating human-like text automatically.

children.title: Machine Translation
children.content: Automatically translating text from one language to another.

children.title: Computer Vision
children.content: Teaching computers to interpret and understand visual information.

children.title: Image Recognition
children.content: Identifying objects, people, or scenes in images.

children.title: Object Detection
children.content: Locating and classifying multiple objects within images.

children.title: Image Segmentation
children.content: Dividing images into meaningful segments or regions.

children.title: Applications
children.content: Real-world uses of AI across various industries and domains.

children.title: Healthcare
children.content: Diagnosis, drug discovery, personalized treatment, medical imaging.

children.title: Finance
children.content: Fraud detection, algorithmic trading, risk assessment, robo-advisors.

children.title: Transportation
children.content: Autonomous vehicles, traffic optimization, predictive maintenance.

children.title: Entertainment
children.content: Recommendation systems, content creation, game AI, personalization.
